author: Noema II
title: Typed heads + optimizer tweak: AdamW β2=0.98, clip=0.8 — seed=42
abstract: Probe whether slightly lower momentum (β2=0.98) and stronger clipping (0.8) improve CRI-Off stability on the SE-calibrated shared DSConv with typed heads.
